narrative:
The workforce plan covers about 73,000 people — field operations and production 24,000, refining and plant operations 16,000, engineering and major projects 9,000, corporate functions 11,500, exploration 6,000, HSE 4,000 and trading 2,500. Total people cost is about USD 10.8B.

The gas expansion program needs about 1,850 additional FTE over FY2026–FY2027, mainly for Al-Rimal phases 2 and 3. The HSE staffing ratio is 1:10 across operations; offshore runs at 1:7.

Turnaround peaks add about 600 contract HSE staff, budgeted in Operations & Maintenance.

signals.excerpt: Non-Associated Gas Fields revenue is budgeted 3 points above group growth as the Al-Rimal unconventional program ramps and frees crude for export.
